title: Peerless
notes: A secret waits at the very top of the mountain, for those who climb from Ascension 1 to 100 without ever falling. In co-op, everyone in the party has to have made the climb. New Game+ climbs count too.
Your climb is tracked from the moment you enter Ascension 1. Going up one Ascension at a time (or staying) keeps it; skipping ahead or dying ends it. Start again from Ascension 1 any time.
New weapon type: Halberds. Two-handed, long reach, and every swing sweeps through up to 3 enemies in front of you.
There is also a new secret class to unlock.
